descriptions.home: Discover verified used and new cars for sale in Addis Ababa. Benefit from 150-point mechanic inspections, title deed verification, and 1.5% fixed commission.
descriptions.showroom: Browse certified inventory of Toyota, Hyundai, Suzuki, BYD electric vehicles and luxury SUVs for sale in Ethiopia with full inspection scorecards.
descriptions.services: Professional auto brokerage services in Addis Ababa: 150-point mechanical audits, Transport Bureau libre verification, and secure bank escrow settlements.
descriptions.compare: Compare specs, prices, fuel efficiency, and inspection ratings of top cars side-by-side to make the best vehicle purchase decision in Ethiopia.
descriptions.about: Learn about Arif Car Sell — Addis Ababa's premier licensed vehicle brokerage committed to transparent pricing, zero hidden markups, and buyer peace of mind.
descriptions.contact: Contact Arif Car Sell at our Bole Medhanialem office in Addis Ababa. Call +251 91 123 4567 or send an inquiry for test drives and vehicle listings.
descriptions.login: Sign in to your Arif Car Sell account to manage your car listings, test drive appointments, and buyer inquiries.
descriptions.register: Create an Arif Car Sell account as a buyer, private seller, or licensed broker to access Ethiopia's trusted vehicle marketplace.
descriptions.terms: Read Arif Car Sell Terms of Service covering listing verification, broker conduct standards, capped commission policies, and buyer protections.
descriptions.privacy: Review our Privacy Policy outlining how Arif Car Sell protects user personal information, phone numbers, and automotive transaction data.
descriptions.help: Find answers to frequently asked questions about buying, selling, inspecting cars, title deed clearance, and broker commissions in Ethiopia.
